workflow_overview.description: set up a new project folder structure
add PDD to an existing project (auto-detects stack and conventions)
explore a problem space, evaluate approaches, and decide what to build
decompose a feature into phases and a prompt chain strategy
improve or refactor an existing prompt
verify and review AI-generated output before committing (includes automated quality checks)
run prompt evaluations and track quality over time

transitions.suggest_next: -> Context: *"Structure is ready. Want to write `pdd/context/project.md`?"*
-> Context: *"PDD structure is ready. Run `/project:pdd-context` to fill in your context files; I'll use what I detected as a starting point."*
-> Research or Plan: *"Context is set. Before writing prompts, want to research the problem space or plan the implementation?"*
-> Help install/configure, or create a prompt adapting the solution
-> Plan: *"Nothing existing fits. Let's plan the implementation."*
-> Prompts: *"Plan is set. Ready to write the first prompt? Start with Phase 1."*
-> Run the prompt 2 to 3 times, then -> Review: *"Run this prompt, then `/project:pdd-review` to verify and review the output."* For critical prompts, create a Level 1 eval first.
-> Re-run the prompt, then -> Review: *"Try the updated prompt and run `/project:pdd-review` on the output."*
-> Fix code, or -> Update if the prompt needs work
-> Commit both prompt and output. -> Eval: *"Consider running `/project:pdd-eval` to track this prompt's quality over time."*
-> Level up the eval if 5 or more runs, or continue to next feature
-> Update: *"These criteria failed. Fix the prompt first."*
